disclaimer: Editorial interpretation of the project's 70+30 rubric, not university grading, historical percentile, calibrated selectivity or admission probability.

bands.label: Needs fundamental revision
bands.typical_evidence: The argument, individual contribution, evidence, disciplinary understanding or clarity is substantially inadequate. Several dimensions require rebuilding.
bands.priority: Revisit the main academic question and reconstruct paragraphs with defensible personal evidence before polishing sentences.

bands.label: Weak
bands.typical_evidence: Some relevant material exists, but reasoning, reflection, concrete contribution or programme fit remains underdeveloped.
bands.priority: Strengthen the most consequential evidence and explain why it matters to the target programme.

bands.label: Developing
bands.typical_evidence: The purpose and some relevant experiences are understandable, yet there are material gaps in analytical depth, focus, evidence or programme coverage.
bands.priority: Resolve substantive missing links before stylistic editing.

bands.label: Good
bands.typical_evidence: A coherent, credible statement with relevant experiences and some reflection; there are identifiable opportunities to deepen the intellectual argument or programme match.
bands.priority: Prioritise one or two highest-impact substantive improvements rather than cosmetic vocabulary.

bands.label: Very strong
bands.typical_evidence: Clear academic motivation, persuasive individual contributions, substantive reflection and convincing programme-relevant evidence, with limited remaining weaknesses.
bands.priority: Improve precision, distinctive reasoning and the weakest evidence link.

bands.label: Excellent
bands.typical_evidence: Consistently strong, specific and well-integrated intellectual evidence; thoughtful limitations or alternatives; major fit is convincingly supported by researched programme context; prose is clear.
bands.priority: Check evidence accuracy, any unresolved gaps and submission compliance; avoid changing substance solely to chase points.

bands.label: Exceptional within this rubric
bands.typical_evidence: Exceptional precision, independence and integration across nearly every dimension, with highly credible examples and nuanced, well-supported programme fit. No major substantive weakness in the judged text.
bands.priority: Verify critical claims and constraints; avoid unnecessary changes.
